# McCombs News and Magazine

> > The news hub for UT Austin's McCombs School of Business, featuring faculty research, business insights, and institutional news across finance, marketing, AI, and sustainable business practices.

McCombs News and Magazine is the official news platform for the University of Texas at Austin's McCombs School of Business, delivering research insights, faculty expertise, program updates, and media coverage. The site aggregates content across multiple formats including articles, podcasts, blogs, and press releases, serving as a central resource for business research, faculty profiles, and institutional announcements.

## Key Topics

- McCombs School of Business
- UT Austin
- Faculty Research
- AI Collaboration
- Sustainable Finance
- Green Bonds
- MBA Programs
- Digital Marketing
- Business Trends
- Research Insights
- Media Mentions
- Faculty Profiles
- KPMG
- UT System
- Business Leadership

## News Hub & Discovery

- [News - McCombs News and Magazine](https://news.mccombs.utexas.edu): McCombs news hub with searchable content on research, faculty, and business trends
- [Search and Filter News - McCombs News and Magazine](https://news.mccombs.utexas.edu/news-filters): Search and filter interface for McCombs news archive and faculty profiles
- [School News - McCombs News and Magazine](https://news.mccombs.utexas.edu/news): McCombs school news covering faculty, research, and master's programs
- [Featured News - McCombs News and Magazine](https://news.mccombs.utexas.edu/featured): Featured McCombs news on AI, faculty research, and sustainable finance

## Research & Insights

- [Big Ideas: Research and Insights from Texas McCombs](https://news.mccombs.utexas.edu/research): McCombs research insights on finance, marketing, sustainability, and economics
- [Behaviors Behind High-Impact AI Use - McCombs News and Magazine](https://news.mccombs.utexas.edu/featured/behaviors-behind-high-impact-ai-use): UT Austin-KPMG study on employee AI collaboration behaviors and productivity
- [Investors Willing To Pay a Little More for Green Bonds](https://news.mccombs.utexas.edu/featured/investors-willing-to-pay-a-little-more-for-green-bonds): McCombs research on green bond premiums and sustainable finance
- [Digital Targeting Creeps Out Customers – McCombs News](https://news.mccombs.utexas.edu/media-mention/digital-targeting-creeps-out-customers): Prof. Wayne Hoyer's research on personalized advertising and consumer behavior

## Publications & Multimedia

- [McCombs Magazine - New Issue!](https://news.mccombs.utexas.edu/current-issue): Current McCombs Magazine issue featuring entrepreneurship and student programs
- [Podcasts – McCombs News and Magazine](https://news.mccombs.utexas.edu/content-type/podcasts): McCombs podcasts including McCombs Made, Voices, and Policy@McCombs
- [Blogs – McCombs News and Magazine](https://news.mccombs.utexas.edu/content-type/blogs): McCombs blog directory covering MBA, master's programs, and business news
- [News Releases - McCombs News and Magazine](https://news.mccombs.utexas.edu/news-releases): Official McCombs news releases on faculty, programs, and achievements

## Faculty & Leadership

- [Leading Forward: David Harrison – McCombs News and Magazine](https://news.mccombs.utexas.edu/news/leading-forward-david-harrison): Faculty spotlight on Associate Dean David Harrison's research leadership
- [Leading Forward: Cory Wilburn – McCombs News and Magazine](https://news.mccombs.utexas.edu/news/leading-forward-cory-wilburn): Profile of CIO Cory Wilburn on technology modernization and digital innovation
- [Equipping Physicians to Lead - McCombs News and Magazine](https://news.mccombs.utexas.edu/featured/equipping-physicians-to-lead): UT System MD-MBA dual degree collaboration for physician leadership

## Media Coverage & Commentary

- [Media Mentions - McCombs News and Magazine](https://news.mccombs.utexas.edu/mccombs-media-mentions): Media coverage and press mentions of McCombs faculty research and expertise
- [How the Iran War and Surging Oil Prices Are Affecting Consumers](https://news.mccombs.utexas.edu/media-mention/how-the-iran-war-and-surging-oil-prices-are-affecting-consumers-at-the-gas-pump-and-beyond): Prof. Ed Anderson on oil prices, inflation, and consumer impact
- [Trump's Tariff Campaign Leaves Companies Rethinking Asset Values](https://news.mccombs.utexas.edu/media-mention/trumps-tariff-campaign-leaves-companies-rethinking-asset-values): Analysis of tariff impacts on corporate balance sheets and asset valuations
